corrections.why: Tennessee Landforms says standing, but the March 26, 2014 list of extant Division of Forestry towers does not include Parsons. The two sources conflict and no later source was found.

notes_for_editor: Only one tower-specific source (Tennessee Landforms) exists for Parsons. It gives the coordinates, elevation, number 8-4 and standing status used in the brief. No build date, design, height, staffing, access or fire history was found in the sources read. The 2014 National Register form omits Parsons, so the standing status is disputed. Shared pages (tnlandforms, the 2014 form, NHLR Tennessee list) were also read for the Pigeon Roost and Pilot Knob stories. Do not confuse this with the Parsons Mountain lookout in South Carolina.
